title: Set 144

sentences.ko: 그 드라마 진짜 좋아했는데, 작가들이 새로 바뀐 뒤로는 인물들이 그냥 줄거리에 필요한 대로만 움직여. 솔직히 이미 다섯 시즌이나 봐 온 게 아까워서 아직 보는 거야.
sentences.text: I used to love that show, but ever since they got new writers, the characters just do whatever the plot needs, so honestly I'm only still watching because I've already put in five seasons.

alts.text: Man, I loved that show, but the new writers just make the characters do whatever the plot needs. Honestly I'm only still watching since I've already sunk five seasons into it.

I was once very fond of that series, but since the new writers joined, the characters simply do whatever the plot requires. Frankly, I continue watching only because I have already invested five seasons in it.

sentences.note: **ever since** 는 그때부터 쭉이라는 뜻이에요. **put in five seasons** 는 다섯 시즌을 들였다는 말로, 시간이나 노력을 쏟았을 때 put in 을 씁니다. 캐주얼하게는 **sunk five seasons into it** 처럼 쏟아부었다고도 해요.

sentences.ko: 야, 우리 거 말고 다른 사람 주문이 온 것 같아. 나는 버거를 시켰는데 드레싱도 없는 샐러드가 왔어. 네가 전화할래, 내가 할까?
sentences.text: Hey, I think they gave us someone else's order. I ordered a burger and I got a salad with no dressing, so do you want to call them or should I?

alts.text: Wait, pretty sure this is someone else's order. I got a salad with no dressing instead of my burger. You wanna call them or should I?
I believe we have received another customer's order. I ordered a burger, but I received a salad without dressing. Would you prefer to call them, or shall I?

sentences.note: **someone else's order** 는 다른 사람 주문이에요. **do you want to call them or should I?** 는 네가 할래 내가 할까 하고 일을 나눌 때 딱 좋은 말이에요. 캐주얼에서는 **You wanna** 로 줄여 말합니다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 다이어트 진짜 잘하고 있었는데, 언니 생일이라서 케이크 한 조각쯤은 괜찮겠지 했거든. 그다음은 뭐 알잖아. 그래서 월요일부터 다시 시작하려고.
sentences.text: I was doing so well with my diet, but then it was my sister's birthday and I figured one piece of cake wouldn't hurt, and you know how that goes. So yeah, I'm starting over again on Monday.

alts.text: My diet was going great till my sister's birthday. I figured one piece of cake wouldn't hurt, and well, you know how it goes. So yeah, starting over Monday.

I was making excellent progress with my diet, but then it was my sister's birthday, and I thought one piece of cake would do no harm. As you can imagine, it did not end there, so I will be starting again on Monday.

sentences.note: **one piece of cake wouldn't hurt** 는 한 조각쯤은 괜찮겠지라는 뜻으로, wouldn't hurt 는 해도 손해 볼 것 없다는 말이에요. **you know how that goes** 는 뻔하지 뭐, 알잖아 하고 뒷얘기를 생략할 때 씁니다. **starting over** 는 처음부터 다시 하는 거예요.

sentences.ko: 이사 도와주고 싶은 마음은 진짜 굴뚝같은데, 그날 아침에 부모님 공항에 모셔다드리기로 이미 약속했어. 그래도 일요일에 아직 짐 싸고 있으면 내가 가서 짐 싸는 거 도와줄게.
sentences.text: I'd really love to help you move, but I already promised my parents I'd drive them to the airport that morning. If you're still packing on Sunday, though, I can come over and help with that.

alts.text: Wish I could help you move, but I already told my parents I'd drive them to the airport that morning. If you're still packing Sunday though, I can come by and help.

I would be glad to help you move, but I have already promised my parents that I would drive them to the airport that morning. However, if you are still packing on Sunday, I would be happy to come over and assist.

sentences.note: **I'd really love to help you move, but** 는 거절할 때 부드럽게 시작하는 말이에요. **drive them to the airport** 는 공항까지 차로 데려다주는 거예요. **come over** 는 상대 집에 가는 걸 말하고, 캐주얼에서는 **come by** 도 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 커피 식는 동안 영상 딱 하나만 보려고 앉았는데, 정신 차려 보니 점심시간이고 연필 만드는 법에 대해 쓸데없이 너무 많이 알게 됐어. 오늘 오전에 한 게 하나도 없어.
sentences.text: I sat down to watch one video while my coffee cooled off, and the next thing I know it's lunchtime and I know way too much about how they make pencils. I didn't get a single thing done this morning.

alts.text: I was just gonna watch one video while my coffee cooled, and suddenly it's lunch and I know way too much about how pencils get made. Got nothing done all morning.

I sat down to watch a single video while my coffee cooled, and before I realized it, it was lunchtime and I had learned far more than necessary about how pencils are made. As a result, I accomplished nothing this morning.

sentences.note: **the next thing I know** 는 정신 차려 보니, 어느새라는 뜻으로 시간이 훌쩍 지났을 때 써요. **way too much** 는 너무 지나치게 많이라는 강조예요. **didn't get a single thing done** 은 하나도 못 했다는 말이고, 캐주얼하게는 **Got nothing done** 이라고 해요.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

reviewed: 2번 formal 이 Excuse me 로 시작해 친구에게 하는 말이 가게 직원에게 하는 말처럼 바뀌었습니다. 빼고 I believe 로 시작하게 고쳤습니다.
4번 note 에서 강조한 I'd really love to help, but 는 문장에 그대로 나오지 않아 실제 문장에 있는 I'd really love to help you move, but 로 바꿨습니다.
5번 text 가 so 로 계속 이어지고 I know 가 두 번 겹쳐 듣기에 버거워서 마지막 줄을 따로 떼었습니다. 한국어의 그래서도 같이 뺐습니다.
5번 formal 의 영국식 철자 realised 를 다른 문장들처럼 미국식 realized 로 맞췄습니다.
